senses.gloss:
mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Astringent.
2 Beardless.
mn. (-रः-रं)
An astringent taste.
f. (-री)
1 A fragrant earth.
2 A kind of lentil, (Cytisus cajan): see आढकी.
E.
तु a Sautra root, to remove, (disease, &c.) थ्वरच् and affix ङीष्; also कन् being added, in the fem. form तुवरिका, f. (-का.)

m. (-रः)
1 A bull without horns, though of an age to have them.
2 A beardless man.
3 A eunuch.
4 An astringent taste.
f. (-री)
A fragrant earth.
E.
तु to injure, ष्वरच् affix, and the vowel optionally long, hence also तुवर and तुवरी; with कन् added तूवरिका and तूवरीका.

m. (-म्बः)
A kind of cassia.
E.
तुवरी the pulse so called, and शिम्ब Cassia tora.

f. (-विः)
A long gourd: see तुम्बी.
